id./param/scenario/cs/c_020_cs_030.pack|cs_: "This is our Elder, Igoltap.

"The Elder has lived since the age of myth.
  He usually sleeps deeply and
  rarely wakes.

"...Hmm, he still doesn't wake. I thought
  Igoltap would wake before the Luminary,
  but it can't be helped.

"I thought Igoltap would wake before the Luminary,
  but it can't be helped.

"I'll tell you the myth of our village.
  ...Please look at this mural.

"In ancient days, the evil god Calasmos
  came to Erdrea for the great power
  sleeping in Yggdrasil.

"The evil god led many monsters
  and defiled the land with miasma.
  The world neared its end.

"...But Yggdrasil, creator of all things,
  foresaw this and sent one savior
  to the earth.

"His name was Erdwin.
  Your ancestor... the legendary Luminary.

"Erdwin flew the skies on Cetacea's back,
  roamed the vast lands of Erdrea,
  and gathered allies to fight beside him.

"...The warrior Neresen, the sage Serenica
  and the mage Morcant: three trusty allies
  gathered around the Luminary.

"The four forged the Sword of Light and
  set out to slay the evil god. After a
  long battle, they brought peace.

"...If that's true, why has the evil god
  we defeated been revived now?
"Sadly... I do not know that either.

"But I know why the Luminary was born.
  You and the evil god are two sides
  of one coin. You were born to defeat him.
"But how are we to confront him...
"The sapling...
"Oh... The Elder has awakened...

"Everyone, quiet.
  The Elder will speak.
Igoltap

"Rely on Yggdrasil's sapling...
  The sapling knows all...

"Yggdrasil's sapling...?
  I see... of course!

"I have something to give you!
  Please come to the Temple of the Sun
  at the entrance!
